info.title: TaskHub agent API
info.description: Bearer tokens are limited to explicit project grants, their profile and their owner’s live access. Tokens never delete items or move them into or out of Done. Hidden resources return the same 404 as missing resources. Agent work is attributed to the owner as username (agent), never to the token name. API routes do not accept session cookies as authentication. No CORS headers are emitted; OPTIONS returns 405. Inputs are strict. v1 may add response fields and enum values. Times are RFC 3339 UTC with milliseconds. String bounds count UTF-16 code units. Reads are bounded at 2 MiB; receipts at 4 KiB. Every allowed mutation requires a UUID Idempotency-Key; replay lasts seven days and is re-authorized. Writes are limited to 60 per token per minute; failed bearer authentication to 20 per IP per minute.
